newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 18.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 18.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors affecting Indian stock markets on Wednesday morning:
** India's 24-sector industrial production index rose 4.8 percent in October over the same month in 1995, the Observer newspaper said on Wednesday
** India's Videsh Sanchar Nigam Ltd and British Telecom plan a 15 billion rupee joint venture to make India hub for international traffic, the Economic Times reports
The joint venture proposes to amalgamate all traffic
from the Middle East, South Asia and South East Asia in India and then transmit to and receive from Britian, thereby making the calls cheaper
** Indian Oil Corporation plans to come out with public equity issue to raise about 20 billion rupees early next year, the Financial Express reports
** Local institutions spurred Indian stocks to higher close on Tuesday
** The 30-share Bombay Stock Exchange index rose 25.37 points, or 0.86 percent, to 2,984.02
** The 50-stock National Stock Exchange index gained 3.47 points to 850.74
** The Indian rupee opened steady at 35.83/84 per dollar and seen quiet, dealers say
